summary: book-4 and appendices (1648 leaves 195-370): candidates found by local OCR (GLM, Tesseract, ABBYY) aligned with the edition, every finding read on the page image by two reviewers (chapters I-IV; chapters V-VII and appendices). book-4 half A (chapters I-IV, 1648 leaves 195-271, printed pp. 172-246): 124 findings -- wording 63, scripture 55, slip 3, reference 3; confidence high 85, medium 36, low 3. Every leaf 195-271 was read on the page image (whole pages, not only the candidate crops), and each row's goold text occurs exactly once in its current .typ file (chap. I's 'So Peter, 1 Epist.' line taken as it now stands). Notes: (1) Rows starting MISPRINT? have proposed = Goold: 'a 1000. words' (worlds; 1648 and Goold both have 'a', so no wording row), 'foure wayes' (five), 'mystery that was made knowne' (no 'not'), 'end of the word' (verse), the skipped 'in[effectual] redemption of all others, but an extending of the same' in chap. III, 'Jeremiah the King' (Jeconiah), 'causes' (classes; medium), 'promised' (premised). (2) Renumbered heads: in chap. III Owen runs the opening heads First/Secondly/[third]/Fourthly; Goold made them (1.)-(3.) and turned 'Fourthly, Let us consider the phrase' into 'Secondly' (one medium row, editor's call). (3) ye/you rows are medium (chap. II opening, chap. III 'let me tell ye', John viii. 24 'If you believe not'). (4) Slips: 'course' for 'cause' (champions of this cause), 'for whom Christ died for' (doubled 'for'), 'then' for 'them' (medium). (5) Most Scripture rows are Owen's own wording that Goold brought to the KJV (John iii. 16 'sent ... on him', Rom. viii. 32 'gave him up', 1 John ii. 2 'a propitiation', John xii. 19 'Perceive ye not', Luke ii. 1, Rom. i. 8, Ps. cxlvii. 19-20, Dan. iv. 35, 1 Thess. v. 21 'try', etc.). (6) Reference rows only where Goold added verses (Rom. iv. 6, Ezek. xviii. 23, 32, Rom. vi. 6-8; all low). (7) Not listed: the Latin 'Mundus sumitur' scheme (handled elsewhere), spelling and punctuation, viz./namely, unto/to in prose, hath/doth, a/an, Goold's bracketed insertions and footnotes, margin captions, and Goold's corrected references (Rom. viii. 34 -> 32, Matth. 10. 45 -> Mark x. 45, Hebr. 5. 20 -> vi. 20, 1 John 4. 22 -> iii. 22, Luke 1 -> ii. 34, 1 Kings 15 -> 2 Sam. xxiv. 10, etc.). | Half B: Book IV chapters V-VII and both appendices against the 1648 first edition, leaves 271-358 (printed pp. 246-333), 433 machine candidates each settled on the page image, plus whole-page reads of the antithesis (leaves 337-338) and of appendices I-II (leaves 347-358). 148 findings: 116 wording, 27 scripture, 3 reference, 1 slip, 1 omission; 94 high, 41 medium, 13 low; 11 marked MISPRINT? (proposed = Goold's text). Scripture rows are Owen's own wording where Goold brought it to the KJV (Rom. xiv. 15, 2 Pet. ii. 1, 20, Heb. x. 29, iii. 12, John i. 10, iii. 3, 19, 1 John v. 19, Isa. v. 4, xlvi. 10, Acts iv. 12, Luke xix. 10, Prov. i. 24, Rom. ii. 12, John viii. 24 in the third person, Ezek. xviii. 23, 32 where Goold rewrote the clause, Gal. i. 8). Prose rows: these/those, the/his, added or dropped articles, 'that', 'to', 'by name', word order, Owen's 'it' for the Spirit in John xvi (Goold 'he', medium). In Thomas More's arguments, which Owen quotes, Goold also brought More's wording toward the KJV and grammar; listed. Slip: 'in bring his minor proposition' (Goold's printing; 1648 'bringing'). Reference: 1 Tim. ii. 6 printed '2 Tim.' in Goold (chap. VI); '2 Cor. v. 10' added; Heb. vii. 28 dropped (appendix II). Antithesis (end of chap. VII): two differences ('ways of life', 'no one saved'). Appendix I: Latin and Greek left to Goold; only Owen's English compared; Goold's unbracketed translations of Prosper (one added, one filling Owen's dash) held low/medium. Not listed: spelling and punctuation, viz./namely, Ans./Answ., ordinals (2ly/Secondly), Goold's corrected references and verse ranges (Heb. ix. 25 -> 26, Matt. xxviii -> xxvi. 28, Heb. iv. 14 -> 15, Epist. 63 -> lxii., verses dropped from long lists such as Isa. viii. 19, Prov. xxx. 5), his bracketed insertions and footnotes, 'T. M.' left as one medium row only once (chap. V) and once in chap. VII, margin captions, Latin/Greek of the Fathers, and the two lines already fixed (those indefinite; works of Christ). Editor's calls: ye/you (3 rows), is/are grammar rows, 'too too', 'Quaere', 'T. M.' vs 'Thomas More', the appendix II title, and the MISPRINT? rows.
